congresses.name: TCT 2026
congresses.note: Venue: San Diego Convention Center (also stated on https://www.tctconference.com/about-tct). CRF announced the late-breaking line-up in a press release dated 26 Aug 2026 (distributed via Newswise), which points to the late-breaking URL above. That page loads its session list with scripts, so the list itself was not read here. The official Program Guide says sessions are still being added.

congresses.name: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026
congresses.note: Venue: McCormick Place Convention Center. The same dates appear on https://professional.heart.org/en/meetings and on the late-breaking science page. AHA pages refuse direct downloads (403), so the dates were read through the web-fetch tool, and three official AHA pages agreed. Online planner: https://eppro01.ativ.me/web/planner.php?id=AHA26

congresses.name: PCR London Valves 2026
congresses.note: Venue: ExCeL London. No late-breaking trial or Hotline listing was found on the official course or programme pages. The interactive programme loads with scripts and its page text did not mention late-breakers, so check again closer to the meeting. A PCR Fundamentals Course runs on 21 Nov 2026.

congresses.name: BCIS ACI 2027
congresses.note: Venue: Hilton London Metropole, hybrid. The official meeting site (run by the BCIS secretariat, Millbrook, and linked from https://www.bcis.org.uk/event/aci-2026/) says the full scientific programme is in development and will be published closer to the meeting. The bcis.org.uk homepage gives the same dates.

congresses.name: CRT 2027
congresses.note: Venue: Washington Hilton. The agenda-at-a-glance is marked DRAFT and subject to change. Late-breaking trial submissions close 15 Jan 2027, so no late-breaking programme exists yet. The official page also lists CRT 2028 as 11-14 Mar 2028, which is outside the window.

congresses.name: ACC.27 (Together With WCC)
congresses.note: Held jointly with the World Heart Federation's World Congress of Cardiology. The ACC late-breaking page (https://accscientificsession.acc.org/Submit-Your-Science/Late-Breaking-Clinical-Trials) is a call for submissions, open 20 Oct to 1 Dec 2026, and does not list accepted trials. The ACC future-meetings page does not list ACC.27; it starts at ACC.28 (1-3 Apr 2028, Chicago).

congresses.name: SCAI 2027 Scientific Sessions
congresses.note: Venue: Broward County Convention Center. The page is a save-the-date ('New schedule for 2027: Sunday-Tuesday') and says more details are coming. No programme has been published.

congresses.name: EuroPCR 2027
congresses.note: Venue: Palais des congres. The page carries a 'Mark your calendars' notice. The 2027 edition will mark 50 years of coronary interventions. No 2027 programme has been published.

congresses.name: New York Valves 2027 (The Structural Heart Summit)
congresses.note: CRF's official site calls this meeting 'New York Valves: The Structural Heart Summit'. No meeting named TVT appears in CRF's meetings menu, so this is recorded as the TVT series. The page is a save-the-date and gives no venue for 2027; the official FAQ names the Javits Center North only for 2026. 'New York' is taken from the meeting name. No programme has been published.

congresses.name: ESC Congress 2027
congresses.note: The main ESC Congress page (https://www.escardio.org/events/congresses/esc-congress/) also says 'See you in Milan, 27-30 August 2027'. No programme or Hot Line sessions have been announced. ESC Congress 2026 (Munich, 28-31 Aug 2026) ended before the window.

congresses.name: TCT 2027
congresses.note: Provisional. These dates come from the event listing on TCTMD, which CRF produces (the footer says 'TCTMD is produced by the Cardiovascular Research Foundation'). The TCT congress site (tctconference.com) does not yet state 2027 dates, and the listing names no venue. Confirm on tctconference.com once it is updated.

congresses.name: AHA Scientific Sessions 2027
congresses.note: Not verified. No official AHA page found states the 2027 dates or location. The AHA meetings list shows only Scientific Sessions 2026, and the official '2027 Exhibiting Opportunities' page (https://sessions.hub.heart.org/industry-resources/press-release/22974569/2027-exhibiting-opportunities) says 'Information coming soon'. It is presumably in Nov 2027, but this is not confirmed.

congresses.name: PCR London Valves 2027
congresses.note: Not verified. The official PCR London Valves pages (course home and About) cover only the 2026 edition and give no 2027 dates. A 2027 edition is presumed to fall in late 2027, but this is not confirmed.
